question: Is the diffuse taxonomic contribution to route-new multi-stop recruitment retained when observer identity and physical stop identity are simultaneously held constant?
sample: Intersection of the existing same-observer matched pairs and pairs with all ten nonmissing identical SiteID values between wet and dry runs.
decomposition: Use the same residualized matched-pair design on the restricted sample; sum species betas to recover the total restricted-sample extra-stop beta.
prefixed_rule: Diffuse if top1 positive share <=0.25, top5 <=0.60, HHI <=0.10, and all leave-one-species-out total betas remain >0.
interpretation: Pass supports broad taxonomic participation within this robust subset; it does not imply every species responds or identify a shared physiological trait.
